scriptedVariables.name: aribaRequestId
scriptedVariables.script: const root=scope?.payload&&typeof scope.payload==='object'?scope.payload:scope;const read=(...paths)=>{for(const path of paths){const value=path.split('.').reduce((obj,key)=>obj==null?undefined:obj[key],root);if(value!==undefined&&value!==null&&String(value).trim()!=='')return value;}return '';};return read('aribaRequestId','requestId','requisitionId','id','document.id','event.documentId','detail.requestId');

scriptedVariables.script: const root=scope?.payload&&typeof scope.payload==='object'?scope.payload:scope;const read=(...paths)=>{for(const path of paths){const value=path.split('.').reduce((obj,key)=>obj==null?undefined:obj[key],root);if(value!==undefined&&value!==null&&String(value).trim()!=='')return value;}return '';};return read('status','state','document.status','event.status','detail.status')||'Updated';
